notes: Issue key in PROJECT-N format. Generated internally; matches Jira key on import.
Parent project identifier. Stored flat internally; nested under fields.project in Jira.
One of: Bug, Chore, Epic, Spike, Story. Stored as a string; Jira nests under issuetype.
Free-text body. Jira uses Atlassian Document Format (ADF); internal stores plain text.
Workflow status string. Jira nests under status.name; internal stores the name directly.
Internal stores a display name or email string; Jira uses an opaque accountId UUID.
One of: Highest, High, Medium, Low, Lowest. Jira nests under priority.name.
Array of label strings. Same structure in both internal and Jira.
ISO 8601 timestamp. Field name differs; value format is equivalent.
ISO 8601 timestamp. Field name differs; value format is equivalent.
Internal stores the Epic key string; Jira uses a custom field ID that varies per instance.
Internal uses a simplified {type, target} structure; Jira issuelinks include inward/outward direction objects.
Internal stores comment objects inline; Jira nests under comment.comments with author accountId references.
Internal stores worklog objects inline; Jira nests under worklog.worklogs with author accountId references.
Internal-only audit trail of status transitions. Jira exposes changelog via a separate REST endpoint, not in the issue body.
Internal-only field that records which external system an issue was imported from. No Jira equivalent.
